## Description

The desk turns an invoice balance into a plan: number of instalments, first due date and frequency, or custom amounts. The schedule prints for the patient to sign. No interest or fees in v1.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Instalments sum exactly to the balance in minor units (the last one takes the remainder).
- [ ] **AC2.** The plan and the patient's acceptance are recorded with who and when.
- [ ] **AC3.** A plan is not a loan: the printed wording is approved by the P4-031 accountant.

## Notes / open questions

- Pick up from DentalERP: the two models and the split logic in app/api/payment-plans. Check its rounding; Medvya uses integer minor units.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
